name: Lagos Premium Condition Review Gate
purpose: Apply the project's evidence-linked premium-condition decision framework to a specific rainwater batch only after collection integrity, QMS/analytical evidence, DMRV review and blockchain anchoring requirements are satisfied. The gate separates eligibility criteria from marketing claims and regulatory release.
required_inputs: blockchain anchor reference where required by policy
rules: Premium status is never inferred from rainfall alone.
Every premium criterion must map to evidence with provenance and applicable acceptance criteria.
Measured, modelled, forecast and proxy evidence retain their classes.
Material unresolved deviation forces HOLD or PREMIUM_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Premium eligibility does not equal regulatory approval or unrestricted commercial release.
Any changed evidence requires a new review/version and successor package/anchor as applicable.
permissible_claims: premium eligibility is established only when the recorded criteria and evidence support that decision
the specific batch has a traceable premium review record
a premium decision is pending, not established, or eligible pending separate release
prohibited_claims: premium status based solely on weather
potable/safe drinking water without applicable evidence
verified GHG reduction without required evidence
blockchain anchor as proof of water quality
